note: Sequential default for one developer. Verification references are trace links, not a declaration of completed tests. Full source scenarios remain authoritative. Phase-specific portions may be verified early; full integration gates are in Phases 08–11.

phases.title: Project initialization
phases.gate: Clean install, static production build and CI baseline; SP-01 passed before further spikes.

phases.title: Technical prototypes and decision gates
phases.gate: SP-02–08 evidence recorded; mandatory architecture blockers resolved or formally stop dependent work.

phases.title: Core domain and command foundation
phases.gate: Schema parity, pure graph validation and atomic command/history foundation pass; no renderer dependency in core.

phases.title: Workspace and canvas
phases.gate: Working local in-memory editor shell with viewport, selection, focus and navigation; persistence explicitly not yet complete.

phases.title: Component library
phases.gate: All 29 registered types insert and render, geometry/anchors and resize validated, local assets present.

phases.title: Connections and routing
phases.gate: Branching, cycles, reconnect and route geometry work; invalid edges never mutate state.

phases.title: Properties and styling
phases.gate: Validated node/edge/group property controls, status and text-fitting behavior work.

phases.title: Grouping and boundaries
phases.gate: Nested group geometry, expansion, explicit membership and safe deletion/duplication pass.

phases.title: Commands and editing history integration
phases.gate: All editing paths use command dispatcher; 50 transactions, cancellation and undo/redo pass.

phases.title: Persistence and recovery
phases.gate: Real browser saves, reload, revision conflict, stale deletion and backup-on-failure verified.

phases.title: Import, export and templates
phases.gate: Both templates, JSON semantic round trip, genuine SVG and PNG with full bounds verified.

phases.title: Testing and stabilization
phases.gate: All mandatory DGS-10 release gates pass with evidence, no blocking defects or unresolved decisions.

phases.title: Deployment and release
phases.gate: Production static artifact deployed only after approval; smoke checks, origin/backup warning and rollback documented.

tasks.title: Repository and specification baseline
tasks.deliverable: Copy unchanged DGS-01–11 and companion fixtures into agreed locations; record checksums, initialize Git, AGENTS.md, README, tracker and decisions; baseline paths verified and no private diagrams committed.

tasks.title: Scaffold and dependency lock
tasks.deliverable: Initialize Next.js App Router static export, TypeScript, Tailwind, React Flow, Zustand, Zod, Dexie and test tooling; record exact stable versions, Node LTS compatibility, lockfile, license/notice review and reproducible install.

tasks.title: CI and test harness
tasks.deliverable: Add lint, typecheck, unit/integration, production build and Playwright scripts; clean runner executes all baseline checks; no secrets or paid services required.

tasks.title: Static shell spike
tasks.deliverable: Serve static output, reload /editor/?id=fixture, verify browser-only initialization and no server route dependency; record build and browser evidence.

tasks.title: Nested boundaries spike
tasks.deliverable: Prove two nested levels, parent motion once, reparent and ungroup preserve world positions, expansion and undo with cross-boundary edges.

tasks.title: Connector spike
tasks.deliverable: Prove four cardinal handles, negative coordinates, resize/reconnect, straight and orthogonal geometry and full scene fit; invalid reconnect keeps ID and endpoints.

tasks.title: Vector export spike
tasks.deliverable: Build minimal controlled SVG/PNG proof with multiline labels, vector icons, markers and nested boundaries; inspect independent viewer, XML safety and font parity.

tasks.title: Persistence spike
tasks.deliverable: Demonstrate transactional CAS in two real browser pages, quota/abort, edit during save and stale deletion; capture outcomes and recovery UI implications.

tasks.title: History spike
tasks.deliverable: Prove compound duplicate/delete/undo, redo invalidation, failed command immutability and 50 transactions using representative graph.

tasks.title: Keyboard and accessibility spike
tasks.deliverable: Prove focus arbitration, native text undo, keyboard alternative to connect/resize, cancellation and visible focus; document gaps.

tasks.title: Performance baseline spike
tasks.deliverable: Run 100-node/150-edge synthetic workload in production shell; capture hardware/browser/build, frame and commit/save/export measurements or explicitly unavailable measurements; DGS-10 owns thresholds.

tasks.title: Architecture review and compatibility decisions
tasks.deliverable: Record each spike result, ADR outcome, font strategy, XML-incompatible text policy and license review; no failed mandatory spike silently waived. Re-run affected prototypes after changes.
tasks.blocker: CR-01 proposed XML-compatible canonical text policy awaits explicit owner approval.

tasks.title: Canonical contracts and runtime schema
tasks.deliverable: Define TypeScript/Zod from DGS-05 v1; strict unknowns, field ranges, finite geometry, UUID/time validation; parity tests against JSON schema and fixtures.

tasks.title: Graph integrity and registry contract
tasks.deliverable: Load trusted registry, validate global IDs, parent types/cycles/depth, eligibility, duplicate directed tuples and status; reject invalid graph atomically.

tasks.title: Coordinate and containment primitives
tasks.deliverable: Pure world/local conversion, bounds and ancestor traversal; test negative/fractional values, expansion and preserved sibling positions.

tasks.title: Command dispatcher and history foundation
tasks.deliverable: Implement typed command results, atomic validation, committed/noop/rejected state, graph-only history API, generation counter and selection reconciliation; wire before UI mutations.

tasks.title: Session and repository interfaces
tasks.deliverable: Define document repository port, session tokens, save-state contracts and version boundary; in-memory test adapter clearly distinguished from real persistence.

tasks.title: Workspace routes and shell
tasks.deliverable: Implement / and query-based editor route, list workspace, create/open and missing-ID states against temporary adapter; header, toolbar, collapsible panels, status bar and neutral design tokens.

tasks.title: React Flow projection adapter
tasks.deliverable: Project canonical nodes/groups/edges, parent-first ordering, stable IDs; renderer measurements/preview transient; no direct committed graph mutation.

tasks.title: Viewport navigation and grid
tasks.deliverable: Pan, pointer zoom 25–200%, fit via scene bounds interface, reset and 20-unit grid/snap independent; complete fit verified again after scene integration.

tasks.title: Selection and hit testing
tasks.deliverable: Single/shift/marquee/full selection, empty canvas clear, overlap priority, noncapturing boundary interior and pointer cancellation; no history on selection.

tasks.title: Keyboard/focus controller and responsive shell
tasks.deliverable: Implement shortcut arbitration and visible alternatives; native input/dialog behavior, focus restoration, desktop panel breakpoints and responsive overflow; final keyboard audit Phase 11.

tasks.title: Component registry and local assets
tasks.deliverable: Import all 29 definitions with typed adapter and local pinned vector icons; validate defaults and inventory, licensing and no remote asset fetch.

tasks.title: Shared primitive geometry and scene
tasks.deliverable: Implement DGS-06 exact primitives, text regions, visual bounds and cardinal anchors; test all 104 eligible anchors and finite shape geometry; export consumes same scene later.

tasks.title: Component library insertion
tasks.deliverable: Implement categories and previews, drag/click/keyboard insert to root, correct transformed placement and one transaction; invalid drop no change.

tasks.title: Move and resize interactions
tasks.deliverable: Implement preview and commit, reference snapping, opposite-side resize, circular aspect lock and floor checks; provisional text measurement replaced with full fitter Phase 06.

tasks.title: Edge creation and graph constraints
tasks.deliverable: Create directed endpoints through pointer and keyboard controls; support branching and cycles, reject exact duplicates/self-loops/annotations/frames and dangling references.

tasks.title: Shared route and marker geometry
tasks.deliverable: Implement deterministic straight/orthogonal paths with endpoint normals, candidate ordering, explicit fallback and path-length label position; finite all handle/overlap cases; shared editor/export scene.

tasks.title: Edge renderer and reconnection
tasks.deliverable: Render selectable edges and preview labels/arrows; reconnect either endpoint with stable ID/style; invalid release restores edge, motion and resize update anchors.

tasks.title: Contextual properties and styles
tasks.deliverable: Implement no/single/mixed-selection inspector, allowed style fields, labels, route/arrows/dash and numeric bounds; invalid edits preserve graph; shared properties update atomically.

tasks.title: Text layout and content fit
tasks.deliverable: Measured local font metrics, Unicode/multiline wrapping, no clipping or silent shrink; grow content or reject invalid dimensions; fit and ancestor growth integrate with Phase 07. Apply approved XML policy.

tasks.title: Architecture status and boundary title controls
tasks.deliverable: Implement four status values for architecture only, marker and text without overriding style; group title and opacity; ensure neutral status backing and readable contrast.

tasks.title: Boundary scene and nesting
tasks.deliverable: Render frames behind descendants, title/border hit regions, dynamic padding; nested children parent-relative, cross-boundary edges intact.

tasks.title: Group and explicit reparent operations
tasks.deliverable: Create same-parent selection group, add/remove membership with world-coordinate preservation and cycle/depth checks; visual overlap never changes membership.

tasks.title: Recursive expansion and resizing
tasks.deliverable: Expand ancestor frames in all directions, rebase child locals to preserve unrelated world positions; boundary resize does not scale children, invalid shrink rejects.

tasks.title: Delete, ungroup and duplicate graph operations
tasks.deliverable: Normalize selected roots, remove incident edges only for deleted nodes, preserve unselected descendants, remap copied internal edges and IDs; undo fully restores transaction.

tasks.title: Full transaction integration
tasks.deliverable: Integrate all graph mutations with existing dispatcher/history; metadata/view excluded, one gesture/label/style commit, cancelled/noop no entry; undo/redo preserve current metadata/revision.

tasks.title: Keyboard actions and history capacity
tasks.deliverable: Finish nudge coalescing, undo/redo availability, duplicate/delete/group shortcuts and keyboard alternatives; test at least 50 graph transactions and redo branching.

tasks.title: End-to-end editor regression
tasks.deliverable: Verify full scene fit, complex multi-selection, stale preview and resource limits; use both reference diagram categories; fix any bypasses of dispatcher.

tasks.title: Dexie repository and lifecycle
tasks.deliverable: Implement documents/viewports/preferences stores, create/open/rename/duplicate/delete and atomic row/view operations; strict loaded content validation, no reset on error; template path completed Phase 10.

tasks.title: Autosave coordinator
tasks.deliverable: 750 ms debounce, 1s max-wait when available, one in-flight immutable snapshot, generation-aware acknowledgement, retry latest, undo saved as new revision.

tasks.title: Cross-tab conflict and recovery
tasks.deliverable: CAS transaction, stale deletion protection, copy/reload/backup, session isolation and pending navigation; test two actual tabs even with notifications disabled.

tasks.title: Viewport, upgrades and failure handling
tasks.deliverable: Independent 500ms viewport debounce without graph revision, safe corrupt-view fallback, blocked upgrade/versionchange, no destructive rollback; test transaction abort and unavailable storage.

tasks.title: Editable backup recovery integration
tasks.deliverable: Expose safe JSON export of current valid in-memory snapshot even when DB unavailable, reusing Phase 02 validation; no stale substitution; final import/export UI Phase 10.

tasks.title: Bounded JSON import and portable export
tasks.deliverable: Implement strict UTF-8/duplicate-key/depth/size checks, v1 validation, ID remap, atomic add-only import and immutable export snapshot; reject unsupported versions and unsafe keys.

tasks.title: Starter templates and independence
tasks.deliverable: Bundle exact DGS-06 flowchart and architecture fixtures, remap all IDs, validate, persist and open; independently editable, immutable sources; template instances JSON round-trip.

tasks.title: Standalone SVG serializer
tasks.deliverable: Generate native safe XML vector output from scene with full bounds, 32-unit white padding, icons, text and statuses; no UI, remote assets or raster wrapper; handle XML errors explicitly.

tasks.title: PNG renderer and preflight
tasks.deliverable: Rasterize same scene at 2x (explicit 1x), 8192 edge and 16 Mi pixel budgets; decode/encode/null/timeout cleanup and correct dimensions; no hidden scale reduction.

tasks.title: File dialogs, handoff and regression
tasks.deliverable: Wire import/export dialog, filename sanitization, stable captured snapshot after draft resolution, browser download handoff; independently inspect PNG/SVG and reimport JSON in target browsers.

tasks.title: Consolidated mandatory traceability suite
tasks.deliverable: Execute every mandatory parent, feature and specialist scenario per DGS-10; evidence with test ID, commit and environment; no unexecuted mandatory checks treated as passes.

tasks.title: Security, accessibility and compatibility audit
tasks.deliverable: Test malformed imports, markup, remote network requests, keyboard-only editing, contrast/focus, licenses and actual Chrome/Edge desktop; use synthetic data only.

tasks.title: Performance and visual fidelity
tasks.deliverable: Measure reference graph on approved hardware/browser, save/export timings and memory; independently inspect vector and PNG; compare approved DGS-10 thresholds, fix regressions.

tasks.title: Usability, defect triage and release candidate
tasks.deliverable: Run pilot tasks and gate review; classify defects, fix and rerun impacted tests; record explicit optional deferrals, approve candidate only with all mandatory gates satisfied.

tasks.title: Production build and deployment approval
tasks.deliverable: Create reproducible tagged static build, verify no private data, licenses and origin warnings; hosting choice and production deployment require owner approval.

tasks.title: Production smoke and rollback
tasks.deliverable: On intended HTTPS origin verify new diagram, save/reload, JSON backup, PNG/SVG, no unintended uploads; test compatible rollback plan and document origin isolation/migration constraints.

tasks.title: Release handover
tasks.deliverable: Record tag, build hash, known issues, test evidence, backup guide and deferred scope; update README/tracker/changelog; release only after owner sign-off.
